profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ One Call | Applied AI
profile.summary:
Hello! 👋 

I’m Agnes - a backend software engineer with experience building cloud-native, scalable distributed systems. My areas of interest are AI-native workflows and product engineering.

Feel free to reach out!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Applied AI

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Scalable Development: REST API development for the Store Inventory and Fulfillment microservices platform using Scala, AWS, and AI tools, providing real-time inventory and O2O order visibility for 1000+ stores globally.
* RFID Inventory Accuracy: Drove key design decisions for Product Attributes, an RFID feature that reflects true sellable inventory by auto-excluding stock allocated to ship-from-store orders and transfer shipments.
* Event Lifecycle Management: Led the design and refactor of a component of the stock domain re-architecture initiative using Scala, AWS Node.js Lambda, and a Kafka streaming platform, ensuring consistent event generation.
* Performance Optimization: Owned AWS account migration for multiple services migrating infrastructure,
coordinating cutover with downstream teams, and resolving post-migration data discrepancies.
* Reliability Improvements: Improved system reliability and MTTR for incidents through observability improvements and production support tool enhancements using JavaScript, React, and Cursor.
* Leadership team member in Women of STEM and Women of Digital employee resource groups: plan and execute professional development events to uplift women in tech
* Mentor to Software Engineer Interns for the past 3 years: provide guidance, advice, and resources during their internship

positions.title: Product Manager (stretch)
positions.description: * Spearheaded the Dotcom Availability feature from discovery and financial outcome analysis to delivery with cross-functional collaboration. Piloted the Style Management MVP for global store users, enabling comprehensive product overviews and filtering, with measurable impact tracked via user feedback and accuracy metrics.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Part of the Early in Career Rotation Program to work in 3 different technology teams for 6 months each.
* Promoted to Software Engineer after 2 rotations.
* Rotation 1 - Enhanced inventory and shipment reporting for store employees by building and refining solutions using AWS, Scala, and Elasticsearch solutions, supporting global retail operations. 
* Rotation 2 - Developed and improved data pipelines with SQL and PySpark for internal retail apps, delivering accurate business metrics to internal teams.

UCSD SWE Board 2019-2020

positions.title: Professional Development Committee Member
positions.description: Plan professional development events such as company mixers, networking workshops, and resume critique and elevator pitch workshops.

positions.title: Team Lead: Envision Committee
positions.description:
Envision is a conference at UCSD held annually in February. It is designed to introduce high school girls to career possibilities in engineering disciplines, including: computer science, bioengineering, mechanical, nanoengineering, electrical, and structural.

As part of the Technical Activities Committee in 2018, I helped design the computer science activity introducing the twenty-five participants to Python, and assisted students with debugging their code. I am currently part of the Technical Activities Committee again for Envision 2019, focusing on front-end development for the computer science workshop.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
* Web App Optimization: Improved security, maintainability, and performance of a web app, Nike Automation Registry, by enabling lookup value search when registering an automation tool using PostgreSQL and Flask. 
* Virtual Assistant Implementation: Implemented a ServiceNow Virtual Agent and NLU Model to provide employees with fast and easy assistance with Zoom requests and incidents through a conversational interface, projecting to save the Nike Service Desk 367 hours per month.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · Flask · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Data Analytics & Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Enterprise Analytics group of the Digital Acceleration team at SDG&E (June 2019 - Sep 2019)
- Performed data analytics by creating multiple dashboards using Power BI and Microsoft SQL Server.
- Communicated effectively with a business group within the company to deliver the dashboards using an Agile workflow and Azure DevOps.

Meter Data Systems group of the Application Services team (Sep 2019 - May 2020)
- Performed QA work for the MDS Team's various web applications.
- Updated the UI of the MDS team's web applications using TypeScript and HTML.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft Power BI · SQL · C# · TypeScript

positions.title: CSE Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Assisted Professors Porter and Griswold’s research group through the Early Research Scholars Program to identify struggling students early in the term by using three weeks’ worth of clicker data and machine learning models to predict students’ final exam scores.

Developed a web-based user interface to match clicker data questions and for instructors to view which students are at risk.

Technologies: Angular, JavaScript, Python, Firebase
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Angular · Python (Programming Language) · Firebase

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
Created a manager-view dashboard for the Power Your Drive program using C#, Bootstrap, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, jQuery, and chart.js through an ASP.NET MVC framework to visualize data of a certain date range from SDG&E’s Electric Vehicle Charging Stations.

Created and deployed multiple reports using SQL queries and SSRS in Visual Studio by accessing the databases through SSMS to acquire data from the Smart Meters. These reports had certain parameters allowing the clients to filter the data accordingly.

Technologies: C#, JavaScript, ASP.NET, Bootstrap, jQuery, SQL

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Instructed groups of elementary to high school students through computer science curriculum such as: Robotics & Coding, Virtual Reality (HTML & JavaScript), 2D Game Design (Stencyl), Android App Development (App Inventor), and Vox-L.

Collaborated with other interns to create web-based apps, including an educational algebra app using C# in Unity and a personality game using JavaScript & HTML in CodePen.
